name: gather
description: Gather, a local-first Markdown writing workspace with reviewable AI and a first-class CLI.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @gather/desktop && npm run build -w @gather/site && npm run build -w @gather/cli
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/editor/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/desktop/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/cli/tsconfig.json --noEmit
